_description: Portkey LLM gateway request log → AKSI control ID mapping. Portkey (https://portkey.ai) is a popular LLM gateway alternative to LiteLLM/OpenRouter that adds caching, retries, fallbacks, load balancing, and guardrails on top of 100+ providers. The /v1/logs endpoint returns one record per upstream call with response status, guardrail verdicts, cache status, fallback/retry counters, and routing config. Status code drives the primary control; guardrail verdicts before/after escalate to FAIL; cache_hit_kind, fallback_used, retry_count, cost, user_feedback, and load-balance routing are additive signals.
